title: Outstanding tour
text: This private tour with Phillipe was outstanding.  He was very knowledgeable and ensured we saw every area including the outside school and Gaudi’s tomb.  Great story telling and made our visit memorable.
author: Lynne_F

title: La Sagrada Família private tour
text: Philippe was an excellent guide. Very knowledgeable and interesting. I would highly recommend this tour. It was great to skip the lines and get right in.
author: Kristine_K

title: Amazing experience. Philippe was awesome.
text: The tour was incredible so private and so knowledgeable. Philippe was so great knew everything about the Sagrada Família and gave me and my partner an experience we will never forget.
author: Anthony_V

title: Great tour guide
text: Philippe was wonderful, very informative tour guide and a good communicator. We highly recommend this tour.
author: Michelle_N
